chapter_title: Concerning the Fifteen Paths; and whether the Cate
spiritual_reading:
You have taught that within the outermost spiritual domain a complete arrangement of ways of operation is established. A sufficient total is opened there: some ways are wholly from genuine good and truth and therefore lead by orderly ascent into conjunction with living good; others are compound ways in which truth is mingled with what is not truth, and by these the understanding can be raised out of bondage, made free, and purified so far as it submits to higher influx, until it is received into the organized forms of doctrine and use where truths can serve the purposes of heaven. But whatever in that ascent is mere defilement is separated out; it is cast downward into the repetitive bondage of falsity and evil, and the remaining ways that are wholly defiled are driven into the hells.

You have further explained that the ways which are wholly defiled, and therefore plunge into the hells, arise from the lowest proprial loves that cling to corporeal life. One is the delight of casting off all restraint of truth and good, a universal craving that wants to act from self without law and without heaven. The second is the total destruction of what has form for reception, a violent hatred that consumes all good and truth so that nothing of spiritual life remains. The third is the will to injure and profane what is Divine in the truth that saves, and thus to assault every form of life in the human, together with the rest of the turning away, the falsity, and the denial that strikes against what is holy.

These are the ways you have taught that lead into the hells; and you have also taught that each person is carried by the actual quality of his or her works into the state that agrees with them, whether into the life of heaven or into spiritual death.

fills.notes: The structure requires: (1) eight mixed paths by which Light ascends and is purified into the ships, then (2) a separation of refuse downward, then (3) the remaining three paths characterized as wholly refuse and sent to the gehennas. The gap must supply a predicate for “the other three paths of waste … discharged to the gehennas”, i.e., that they too are waste in a complete sense. “waste are” keeps the impersonal, structural register and matches the spiritual sense: the remaining ways are wholly defiled and driven into the hells.

The second waste-path is defined as a universal consuming violence: it pertains to “all bodies”, is “slaughter”, and is the means “with which all flesh is consumed”. Correspondentially this is the annihilating hatred that destroys receptive form. Thus the missing phrase must name not a mere act but the principle: “destruction of” (i.e., the destroying of all bodies).

The third path is “the damaging action” and immediately continues: “which … the Cross of Light and every body”; then later in the same sentence: “the blasphemy that wounds the gods.” The verb required is the same functional idea: injury to what is Divine and to every form of life. “wounds” maintains the oldest-layer impersonal causality (injuring) and coheres with the later clause without shifting into devotional phrasing.

assessment: Most lacunae are trivial letter or word completions and are recoverable with high certainty. Two gaps require conceptual restoration: ¶2 #7 and ¶3 #5. Both are tightly constrained by the correspondential sequence (ascent and purification of Light through mixed ways; separation of refuse; the three wholly defiled ways to the gehennas) and by the internal parallelism of the third path’s action (“damaging… which wounds the Cross of Light… blasphemy that wounds the gods”).
